recommendedMoves: First repair the release evidence authority so one scheduled bye or incomplete week cannot make a rendered-pixel gate nondeterministic.
Then promote the cross-season Decision Anthology from a one-time epilogue fragment into a permanent year-selectable History archive.

items.title: The cross-season Decision Anthology disappears when the season-review modal closes
items.premise: Session 73 builds bounded cross-season volumes, but only seasonEpilogue.js imports the model. The permanent History surface offers Season Awards and Hall of Fame only, so a player cannot revisit prior General Manager decisions after dismissal or reload.
evidence: public/lib/decisionAnthology.js builds year-grouped volumes and bounded turning points
public/lib/seasonEpilogue.js is its only browser importer
public/game.html History navigation has only season-awards and hall-of-fame views
items.constraint: Reuse the existing non-causal ranking authority. Sparse seasons remain visibly incomplete; do not claim decisions caused outcomes or manufacture missing receipts.
verification: pure archive model and rendering tests

L1.recipe: Render the existing volume headlines in a static History panel.

L2.recipe: Add a Decision Archive History view with a year selector, source-coverage status, receipted turning-point cards and explicit non-causal/missing-evidence copy; hydrate it from the same dashboard authorities as Season Epilogue and cover navigation plus sparse states.

L3.recipe: L2 plus cross-link every card into exact transaction, draft and weekly-plan evidence surfaces.

items.title: The required Pages visual gate depends on one advance-week call producing a game receipt
items.premise: The latest Deploy Pages run failed after build and smoke passed because responsive-evidence.mjs advanced one week, found no recentBoxScores/latestBoxScore id, and aborted. A bye or non-game phase can make the exact same source revision red.
evidence: GitHub run 31069185396 failed with 'Sim-Watch visual evidence could not find a receipted game'
responsive-evidence.mjs makes exactly one POST /api/advance-week request
the same script already constructs deterministic source-derived visual fixtures for Architect's Cut
items.constraint: Do not retry luck, skip required captures or fabricate scores. Build a deterministic archived game through the real runtime/receipt authority and prove the chosen game has exact play-by-play before opening Sim-Watch.

L1.recipe: Retry advance-week until a game appears.

L2.recipe: Extract a deterministic visual-game resolver that advances through bounded real runtime states, rejects byes/incomplete receipts, returns an exact archived game id with play-by-play, and fails with a diagnostic ledger rather than probabilistic absence; unit-test the resolver and wire responsive evidence to it.

L3.recipe: L2 plus reuse the fixture authority across Playwright journeys and publish its seed/week/game receipt in the visual report.

items.title: AI agents can discover the project but cannot receive a bounded live franchise brief
items.premise: agents.json identifies the public project and legal entrypoints but has no dynamic state contract. Players can export full saves and narrative cards, yet cannot copy a compact, privacy-bounded packet containing the current decision, pressure, cap/roster posture, season thesis and receipted history for a human or AI Co-GM.
evidence: public/agents.json has metadata plus Play/Contact/Privacy/Terms only
the live dashboard already owns franchise command, roster needs, cap, owner pressure, season thesis and bounded Architect receipts
existing feedback code demonstrates a fixed allowlist and disclosure-budget pattern
items.constraint: No API call, hidden ratings, tokens, absolute local paths, raw save, personal data or fabricated recommendation. Packet schema and omissions must be explicit; copy/download happens only after a player click.
verification: pure packet allowlist and size-bound tests

L1.recipe: Copy a short plaintext summary from the Overview card.

L2.recipe: Create a versioned Co-GM briefing packet with allowlisted identity, current command, pressure, cap/roster posture, thesis and bounded receipts; expose Copy JSON and Download buttons in Franchise Command, declare the schema in agents.json, and surface exact disclosure/omission copy.

L3.recipe: L2 plus a player-selected question/intention field and importable response annotations that never mutate game state automatically.
